name: Airtable
whatYouLose: A general-purpose relational schema builder with many field types
Automations, interfaces, extensions, permissions, and sync connectors
Robust collaborative editing on large bases
prompt: Build a purpose-built content operations database. Model campaigns, assets, owners, channels, statuses, due dates, and related deliverables in SQLite. Provide spreadsheet, kanban, and calendar views; inline editing; saved filters; CSV import/export; attachments stored on disk; audit history; and a read-only share view. Make the schema explicit in code instead of building a universal database designer. Use Astro SSR, vanilla JavaScript, transactions for edits, and a password-protected admin.
notes: The winning move is not cloning Airtable. It is coding the exact relational workflow your team actually uses.
